content.specificationName: Enable Hot-Reload for MCP Clients in Development Mode
content.purpose: Enable testing metabob-cli code changes without restarting opencode session

changesApplied.changeMade: Added export async function reload() that: (1) Gets current state, (2) Closes all existing clients, (3) Clears state, (4) Re-reads config via Config.get(), (5) Re-initializes clients using create(), (6) Returns success status and errors per client
changesApplied.reason: Enables hot-reload of MCP connections without restarting entire opencode session. Allows developers to test metabob-cli code changes immediately after restarting the vessel.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: New export function - no breaking changes. Only called explicitly via CLI command or config reload. Selective disposal (only MCP clients) preserves other cached state.
designDecisions: Selective disposal: Only MCP clients, not full Instance.dispose()
Graceful error handling: Continues reload even if individual clients fail
State manipulation: Directly updates state object rather than disposing
Reuses create(): Leverages existing initialization logic

changesApplied.changeMade: Added: (1) Import MCP module and Log utility, (2) Log instance creation, (3) MCP.reload() call after Instance.dispose() in reload() function, (4) MCP.reload() call in performDeferredReload() function
changesApplied.reason: Ensures MCP clients are re-initialized immediately when config changes, not lazily on next access. Provides automatic hot-reload when opencode.json MCP config changes.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk: Only adds logging and MCP reload call after existing Instance.dispose(). Errors are caught and logged, won't break config reload flow.
designDecisions: Call after Instance.dispose(): Ensures fresh config is loaded
Error handling: Logs errors but doesn't fail entire reload
Applied to both: reload() and performDeferredReload() functions

changesApplied.changeMade: Added: (1) Import MCP module, (2) McpReloadCommand with 'opencode mcp reload' command, (3) Updated McpCommand builder to include McpReloadCommand, (4) Command handler that calls MCP.reload() and displays formatted results with status per client
changesApplied.reason: Provides manual trigger for hot-reload during development. User can run 'opencode mcp reload' after restarting MCP vessel to reconnect without restarting opencode session.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero risk: New CLI command only. No changes to existing commands. Uses prompts/spinner for user feedback. Displays success/failure per client with errors.
designDecisions: User-friendly: Spinner, color-coded status, detailed error messages
Non-breaking: Graceful failure - shows partial success if some clients fail

dataFlowValidation.manualReloadFlow: User runs 'opencode mcp reload' → McpReloadCommand → MCP.reload() → close clients → Config.get() → create() → return status → CLI displays results
dataFlowValidation.automaticReloadFlow: User edits opencode.json → config/reload.ts detects → canReloadSafely() → Instance.dispose() → MCP.reload() → new clients ready
dataFlowValidation.deferredReloadFlow: User edits opencode.json → reload deferred → next session → performDeferredReload() → Instance.dispose() → MCP.reload() → new clients ready
verifiedRipples: MCP.reload() calls create() - existing function, no changes needed
MCP.reload() calls Config.get() - existing function, re-reads config correctly
Config.reload() calls MCP.reload() - new integration point, tested
CLI command calls MCP.reload() - new integration point, tested

testScenario.setup: metabob-opencode running with metabob-cli as MCP vessel
steps: Modify metabob-cli code (e.g., add logging to search_activities tool)
Restart metabob-cli vessel to pick up code changes
Verify: New logging appears when calling metabob_search_activities
Alternative: Use test_metabob_mcp tool to verify connection and tools updated
testScenario.expectedResult: MCP clients reconnected with new vessel code, no opencode restart required

componentsWithNoChanges.reason: Already handles client initialization gracefully - reused by reload()
Already detects MCP config changes - no changes needed
Already functional for verifying reload success - no changes needed
canReloadSafely() stub acceptable for MVP - manual reload gives user control

risksMitigated.mitigation: Followed Instance.state() pattern carefully. Direct state manipulation tested.
All clients closed before re-initialization. Error handling ensures cleanup.
Manual reload gives user control. Future: implement safety checks in canReloadSafely().
Circuit breaker state preserved (lives outside MCP state) - correct behavior.

architectureCompliance.instanceStatePattern: ✓ Used Instance.state() correctly - direct state manipulation without full dispose
architectureCompliance.disposalVsReload: ✓ MCP.reload() is selective - only MCP clients, preserves other state
architectureCompliance.createReusability: ✓ Reused existing create() function - no duplication
architectureCompliance.errorHandling: ✓ Graceful error handling - continues on individual client failures
architectureCompliance.logging: ✓ Detailed logging at each step for debugging
